title: Conditional state-weighted edge majorant from the existing Q3 moment interfaces
question: Can the already registered endpoint third-moment bridge and local-force L4 interface be composed into a state-weighted per-edge majorant for scalar history coefficients dominated by the existing shell weight, without identifying that norm with an operator-norm Q3LOCK estimate?

composition.moment_parent: EXP-001060 fixed-beta periodic zero-source endpoint third-moment bridge

definitions.edge_bound: If |a_e|<=w_e and w_e>=0, then ||a_e F_e||_L4 <= C_L4_edge*w_e

logic: The force parent supplies |F_e|^4 <= force_constant^4*D^3*E_pair^3 on its declared finite force fixture.
The moment parent supplies E(E_pair^3) <= M_bridge in its fixed-beta periodic zero-source scope.
Multiplication by a scalar history coefficient and |a_e|<=w_e give the fourth-power edge bound.
The L4 corollary uses homogeneity and the nonnegative fourth root; a sum over edges still additionally requires the triangle inequality and the existing R-445 tail geometry.

finite_fixture.fixture_scope: Exact arithmetic and conditional norm composition only; no new Gibbs trace or Q3 matrix calculation is introduced.

assumptions: The force inequality and its constant are used exactly within the finite fixture and scope of EXP-001059.
The endpoint third-moment bound M_bridge is used exactly within the fixed-beta periodic zero-source scope of EXP-001060.
Each scalar history coefficient satisfies |a_e|<=w_e with w_e>=0.
The state-weighted L4 norm is homogeneous; an eventual edge sum may use the triangle inequality only after its state/domain contract is supplied.
All derived constants are recomputed from the two parent manifests rather than copied as independent inputs.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK history construction that supplies the coefficients a_e and shell weights w_e for every actual edge and both orientations.
A common unbounded-domain definition that turns the finite local-force L4 interface into the required operator or form seminorm.
Source-, beta-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase- and history-uniform moment and force constants beyond the parent scopes.
A two-sided product/Volterra estimate, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy theorem and common-alpha identification.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

adversarial_review.check: The force and moment constants are loaded from EXP-001059/EXP-001060 and the output remains restricted to their fixed-beta finite periodic zero-source interface.
The derived bound is explicitly an L4 state-weighted conditional bound; operator_norm_of_actual_q3_terms and actual_q3_history_identification remain false.
The finite pairs retain signs, test |a_e|<=w_e, and use w_e only through a fourth-power monotonicity step; no cancellation or fitted shell constant is used.
No history sum, common domain, exhaustion, common alpha, QFT, physical, continuum or mass-gap flag is enabled by this composition.
The package composes existing R-241/R-242 interfaces for T-054 and does not alter the forward theorem order, candidate definitions or inverse lane.

evidence_level: T0 exact conditional state-weighted fourth-power composition
boundary: This package discharges only a restricted state-weighted edge-majorant interface by composing already registered finite/conditional Q3 inputs. It does not prove an actual Q3LOCK operator norm, history recurrence, common weighted domain, common core, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, physical sector, continuum, C6, Sector-A, Pre-A or mass gap.
non_claims: No actual Q3LOCK commutator or history term is shown to satisfy the coefficient hypothesis.
The fourth root is a symbolic L4 constant, not a new uniform numerical estimate.
The fixed-beta periodic zero-source parent scopes are not extended to compact sources, arbitrary boundaries, beta limits or thermodynamic volume.
No operator norm, common-core, Lie-Robinson, Volterra, Duhamel, exhaustion, KMS/GNS, physical-empty, Yang--Mills or mass-gap conclusion follows.
The established research method and owner order remain unchanged.
next_action: Use this L4 interface as a named conditional input only if a later owner-level Q3LOCK history supplies |a_e|<=w_e on the same state/domain. The next actual proof obligation remains the source-owned common-domain history/commutator estimate; do not create another equivalent finite grid.
stop_or_redesign: If a future parent changes the force or moment scope, recompute this composition from the new hashes rather than reusing C4_edge.
If an actual history coefficient fails |a_e|<=w_e, keep the failure local to that history contract and do not repair it by enlarging the constant after seeing the target.
If conversion from L4 state norm to operator/form norm is unavailable, retain this as a conditional interface and do not promote R-445.
If a future change would modify the established T-054 method or owner order, return to the P0 continuity gate first.
